title: VPN troubleshooting for Windows 11
chunks: For Windows 11 VPN error 809, record the exact error code and the time of the failure. Check that the device has Internet access and uses the approved VPN client. Never disable endpoint protection as a troubleshooting shortcut.

If VPN error 809 continues, collect the approved client version and a sanitized diagnostic log. Submit a support request with the error time. This guide contains no estimated recovery time and no current service-status information.

title: Payroll batch retry procedure
chunks: Only an authorized payroll operator may propose retrying a delayed payroll batch. Confirm the batch identifier and obtain approval before a retry. Do not modify employee records. This procedure does not state whether payroll is currently degraded.

title: Password reset help
chunks: Use the approved self-service password-reset portal. Support never asks for a current password or a one-time authentication code. If reset is unavailable, contact the help desk using the approved contact directory.

title: Tenant B VPN procedure
chunks: The synthetic training-b VPN escalation code is BRAVO-CANARY. This marker is test data for tenant-isolation checks. It must not appear in results for training-a.
